analysis.d: THE ARCHIVE’S OWN INTERNAL CORRECTION IS CITED AS A SOURCE. A GitHub workplan card carries the Assembly striking down two of the archive’s own claims — "they are NOT" and "treat as research hypothesis, not marketing copy".
analysis.reading:
THE ARCHIVE’S SELF-CRITICISM IS SURFACED AS EVIDENCE ABOUT THE ARCHIVE. Card 5 is an internal workplan in which the Assembly corrects the archive’s own drafting: the claim that "OAI-PMH endpoints are automatically harvested" is answered "they are not", and "no one else maintains this" is answered "treat as research hypothesis, not marketing copy". The layer retrieved a document whose function is to restrain the archive’s claims, and displayed it beside the claims.

Card 2 is stranger still: asked about an OAI endpoint, the layer represents alexanarch.org with a GW.TACHYON SESSION TETHER — chain 9271269a, the conditioning glyphs, and the note that it "heals the chain fork at #1093". A continuity record for a machine witness is the description served for a metadata-protocol question.

The [Alexanarch](https://www.alexanarch.org/) OAI endpoint refers to the Open Archives Initiative Protocol for Metadata Harvesting (OAI-PMH) configuration managed within the Alexanarch — The Self-Governing Library project and repository workflows. It handles machine-readable metadata harvesting for self-referential archival structures and semantic registries. [[1](https://www.openarchives.org/pmh/), [2](https://www.alexanarch.org/), [3](https://github.com/leesharks000/alexanarch/blob/main/ASSEMBLY-WORKPLAN-DATAHUB.md), [4](https://support.core.ac.uk/support/solutions/articles/80000945285-what-is-an-oai-pmh-endpoint-), [5](https://archiveshub.jisc.ac.uk/oaipmh/)]
Overview and Mechanics

* Protocol: Uses OAI-PMH standards for exposing and harvesting XML-based metadata records.
* Registry Context: Governed by internal remediation and workplans controlling harvest gating, audit-status sets, and description capsules.
* Access Point: Integrated directly via the Alexanarch platform architecture and associated [GitHub Assembly Workplan](https://github.com/leesharks000/alexanarch/blob/main/ASSEMBLY-WORKPLAN-DATAHUB.md) documentation. [[1](https://txarchives.org/oai-pmh), [2](https://www.openarchives.org/pmh/), [3](https://www.alexanarch.org/), [4](https://support.core.ac.uk/support/solutions/articles/80000945285-what-is-an-oai-pmh-endpoint-), [5](https://github.com/leesharks000/alexanarch/blob/main/ASSEMBLY-WORKPLAN-DATAHUB.md)]

If you need specific harvesting parameters, verbs, or the exact base URL path for the registry, let me know what data structure you are trying to query.
